title: Design System: PONTO X Comunicação Visual

display.purpose: Hero H1 only; lights up once like an LED letter.

display-secondary.purpose: Hero H2 only; replaces the H1 on scroll.

headline.purpose: Every section title and the hero closing CTA; Archivo expanded (wdth 118), revealed word by word.

title-large.purpose: Service group names and process step titles.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The system casts no box shadows; depth is tint and colour-field contrast.

shadows.name: led-glow-rest
shadows.purpose: Text glow on hero H1/H2 only (brief exception).

shadows.name: led-glow-peak
shadows.purpose: Peak of the one-time LED light-up keyframe on the hero H1.

shadows.name: scrim-top
shadows.purpose: 160px legibility veil under the transparent header over the hero video.

shadows.name: scrim-bottom
shadows.purpose: Legibility veil under hero text, 62% of viewport height.

shadows.name: red-glow

motion.name: ease-out-expo

motion.name: panel-expand

motion.name: lightbox-grow

motion.name: marquee
motion.purpose: Brand name strip; pausable, static under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Reveals show immediately, hover offsets removed, marquee wraps, hero scrub unsmoothed, timeline complete, no lightbox grow, no smooth scroll.

narrative.overview:
The site is printed, not decorated. Three inks taken from the PONTO X logo (a tinted near-black, the logo's own red, and a warm paper white) are laid down in flat, full-bleed fields, and the only graphic device is the diagonal cut of the X, at roughly 36 degrees. That cut shows up as red bands crossing light sections, a clipped top-right corner on photos and buttons, slanted section tops that overlap the section above, small skewed red ticks used as bullets and separators, and a diagonal wipe into the hero's closing call to action.

Density is generous and editorial: big expanded Archivo headlines, wide margins driven by a fluid gutter, long vertical rhythm between sections, and real client photography doing the persuading. Dark and light sections alternate (ink, paper, ink and red, paper, ink, paper, ink) so the page reads like a stack of printed sheets. Corners are square everywhere except where the X cuts them. There are no rounded corners, no drop shadows, and no icon-card grids.

Motion behaves like a sign being installed and switched on. The hero video is scrubbed by scroll, not autoplayed. The hero H1 lights up once like an LED letter. Section titles assemble word by word. Blocks rise into place, and on desktop a soft red light follows the pointer across service panels and project cards.
keyCharacteristics: Three inks only: ink, logo red, paper. Tints of ink (ink-2, ink-3) and paper (paper-2) separate surfaces.
One motif: the X's ~36° diagonal cut. Nothing else is ornamental.
Square geometry (0px radius), with the clip-path corner cut as the only departure.
Expanded, heavy Archivo for titles. Big Shoulders is reserved for the two hero headlines (signage letters).
Flat surfaces. Depth comes from colour-field contrast, overlapping slanted edges, and the scrims and glows the brief asks for.

rules.name: The Three Inks Rule
rules.body: Every surface is ink, red or paper (or one of their listed tints). No other hue enters the system; photography carries all other colour.

rules.name: The Signal Red Rule
rules.body: Logo Red is for fields, bars, bands and large type. Small red text or outlines on a dark ground use Signal Red instead, for contrast.

rules.name: The Sign Face Rule
rules.body: Big Shoulders appears only in the hero H1 and H2. Every other heading, including the hero's closing CTA, is Archivo.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headlines, buttons and nav are set in sentence case; the type gets its loudness from width and weight, not capitals.

rules.name: The Flat Print Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never cast shadows. If something needs to lift, put it on the next tint (ink to ink-2 to ink-3) or on red.

rules.name: The Glow Belongs to the Sign Rule
rules.body: Text glow is for the hero sign lettering only. Red radial glows sit only on dark sections, never on paper.

dos: Do build every surface from ink, ink-2, ink-3, red, paper and paper-2; let photography bring all other colour.
Do cut media and square controls at the top right with the X cut (26px, 72% drop) and keep every other corner square.
Do use the 14px notch on buttons: clipped on primary, a red triangle on ghost.
Do keep the diagonal at 36°: bands, skewed ticks, slanted section tops and wipes all share it.
Do use Signal Red for small red text and focus outlines on dark grounds, and Logo Red for fields and large type.
Do set section titles in Archivo 800 at wdth 118 and reveal them word by word.
Do alternate dark and light sections so the page reads as a stack of printed sheets.
Do give every motion a reduced-motion fallback that keeps state and colour changes.
donts: Don't round corners or add box shadows; depth comes from tints, red fields and overlapping slants.
Don't use Big Shoulders outside the hero H1 and H2.
Don't introduce a second motif (circles, waves, gradients as decoration) next to the X cut.
Don't put red radial glows on paper sections or text glow outside the hero sign lettering.
Don't add eyebrow labels above titles; the two in Quem somos and Vídeos are brief-specific exceptions, not a pattern.
Don't show third-party client logos; client names appear as text.
Don't autoplay video with sound; the hero is scrubbed silently and the video cards play only on a click.
